china-1914:p0049_1.rationale: Monthly barometer, temperature and rain/snow readings for Weihaiwei in 1910 are weather observations.

china-1914:p0050_1.rationale: Classification of Mongoloid races by family, division, tribe and habitat is textual and describes ethnic composition. No statistical quantities appear.

china-1914:p0054_1.rationale: List of Manchu dynasty rulers with reign years; reign dates are incidental, so the content is textual.

china-1914:p0059_1.rationale: Export values abroad in 1912 for the chief Chinese products; this is a trade table with several commodities, so exports is the apt tag.

china-1914:p0061_1.rationale: Textual list of principal Chinese products (animal products, fibres, metals, oilseeds) and their regions of origin. It is a multi-commodity inventory with no quantities, and no existing tag fits such a mixed list.
review_questions: Propose a tag for regional product inventories or commodity geography.

china-1914:p0062_1.rationale: Continuation of the textual list of principal products (oils, timber, silk, tea, sundries) and their provinces of origin. It has no quantities and no fitting aggregate tag.
review_questions: Propose a tag for regional product inventories or commodity geography.

china-1914:p0063_1.rationale: Textual list of principal export products by province with ports of export and routes. It is a multi-commodity inventory with no quantities, and no broad tag fits.
review_questions: Propose a tag for export products by province and port or for commodity geography.

china-1914:p0069_1.rationale: Percentage shares of world silk trade by country, 1903-1912; silk is the commodity.

china-1914:p0070_1.rationale: Shares of silk export value by product type and the chief ports of original export in 1912.

china-1914:p0071_1.rationale: Value of silk exported from China 1908-1912 in taels and sterling.
